title: Monthly budget frontmatter (finance/months/YYYY-MM/budget.md)
description: One month's plan: expected income, envelope allocations (envelope mode), or awareness targets (awareness mode). Arithmetic invariants (allocations vs income) are enforced by scripts, not by this schema.

allocations.description: Envelope id -> planned amount. Present in envelopes/hybrid mode.

awareness_targets.description: Category key -> soft awareness ceiling (no allocation, no shaming). Present in awareness/hybrid mode.

overlay.description: Month-specific items beyond the recurring baseline; yearly-bank items land here highlighted at planning time.

source.description: yearly_bank = auto-suggested due item (render highlighted); carryover = from last month's reconciliation.
